description: Hyperliquid public trader leaderboard: top accounts ranked by PnL for a chosen window (day, week, month, allTime), with account value, ROI and traded volume. Public on-chain stats; addresses only, no names. The source file is large, so the first call after a cache miss is slow. Related tools on this server, for a different need: b2b_pgatour_leaderboard when you need PGA Tour current and upcoming events from ESPN's public; b2b_openllm_leaderboard when you need Open LLM Leaderboard v2: finds open-source language models. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
